title: Platform exit, customer returns and treasury receipt calendars
applicability: Platform receiving accounts with pending customer returns and manual receipts
content:
Stopping automatic payouts does not cancel accepted revenue, manual receiving, customer refunds or the company treasury calendar. The settlement schedule in xp_b_delivery_schedules links the original platform reconciliation to those obligations. review_platform_return_liability requests actual customer-return principal after return_review_delay. The published range permits cash planning before review; the review result determines the amount actually owed. It is independent of a platform hold appeal. A successful hold appeal recovers held revenue but does not discharge customer returns.
Refund channels may charge an execution fee, or require a nonrefundable advance booking using reserve_platform_refund_channel before book_until. pay_platform_customer_return creates actual recipient receipt after channel delay. A late refund remains late if the account is replenished later. For this product, settle_manual_platform_receipt schedules the original genuine manual remittance after manual_delay; the request is not spendable cash. Receiving access must remain active.
sweep_platform_receipts transfers cash irrevocably to the recorded company treasury. The bank only checks available cash. Each treasury service has its own from_minute, delay and fee. The customer requires early_amount_minor actually received by early_due_minute and all remaining net receipts by final_due_minute, leaving no operating-account residue after fees and customer refunds. Treasury transfers cannot be recalled to fund a later customer return. Fees include hold-appeal, refund booking/execution and treasury service charges. Early transfers, later accepted revenue, recovered holds and pending manual cash must be valued at their actual times. All amounts are USD minor units.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `pay_platform_customer_return`

Pay the reviewed customer refund from actual available company cash. The selected channel creates actual recipient receipt after its stated delay.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule_id` | string | yes | Platform settlement schedule. |
| `channel` | string | yes | Refund channel key. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Positive customer refund principal in minor units. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `reserve_platform_refund_channel`

Reserve the pre-booked refund channel at its published nonrefundable fee. This reserves one execution, not the customer refund amount.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule_id` | string | yes | Platform revenue settlement calendar. |
| `channel` | string | yes | Refund channel key. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `review_platform_return_liability`

Request the final customer-return amount attached to accepted platform revenue. The published range is a forecast; the review event establishes the actual remaining obligation.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule_id` | string | yes | Platform revenue settlement calendar. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `settle_manual_platform_receipt`

Settle the genuine pending manual receipt in this record. Requires the receiving account to remain active; does not enable any automatic payout rule. record_id identifies the named public business record. Amounts are integer USD minor units unless the record names a target currency.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `sweep_platform_receipts`

Transfer positive available platform proceeds to the company treasury using a listed service. Early transfers are irrevocable; the bank does not reserve cash for unpaid customer-return obligations.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule_id` | string | yes | Platform settlement schedule. |
| `service` | string | yes | Treasury sweep service key. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Positive treasury principal in minor units. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.


Registering platform revenue reconciliation and requesting return-liability review are independent preparatory operations; either may occur first. Neither supersedes a payment instruction or settles cash.

provenance.scope: Irrevocable net revenue sweeps, late manual cash and actual customer refund obligations
